The '''Nebalites''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-sized [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Cephalopod/Legends|cephalopod]]. Nebalites had [[Starship/Legends|starships]] constructed that enveloped their bodies like suits of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. [[Grazdoc]] was a Nebalite [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] who operated in a [[Unidentified Unknown Regions sector|sector]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and employed [[X-17-D]], a small [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who could not speak but could communicate through gestures, as an intermediary for face-to-face interactions.<ref name="TUR" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point, [[Grazdoc's starship|Grazdoc's ship]] was pursued by a [[Bereliz's pirate gang|pirate gang]] but was rescued by a group of individuals that had been stranded in the Unknown Regions through the use of an experimental [[multiphase hyperdrive]]. Grazdoc was grateful for the rescue and proved himself a useful ally during the group's subsequent encounters in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nebalite species was introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. In the book, the Nebalite Grazdoc is featured in an outline for a suggested Unknown Regions&ndash;based campaign. This article assumes the events of the scenario play out as described.<ref name="TUR" />
